publication_rule: Only records with publish_ready=true should appear in the public event directory.
active_event_rule: status in [upcoming, recurring] and either end_datetime is in the future, or end_datetime is null and the local event date has not passed
expiration_rule: Events with a known end_datetime expire after that time. Events with an unknown end_datetime require review after the local event date and are then moved to ended/archive.

schema_notes.end_datetime_policy: end_datetime may be null when the organizer has not published an ending time. Such records require manual review after the event date and must not be assigned an invented ending time.
schema_notes.source_integrity_rule: Do not infer a street address, ending time, ticket link, or organizer URL that was not supported by the supplied source.
